TABLE.NAME: leaderboard
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per leaderboard activity. Rankings are calculated from the gradebook, so no per-user data is stored here.

FIELD.NAME: assignpoints
FIELD.COMMENT: Points per assignment mark when submitted on time.

FIELD.NAME: assignlatepoints
FIELD.COMMENT: Points per assignment mark when submitted after the student's due date.

FIELD.NAME: zoompoints
FIELD.COMMENT: Points per Zoom mark (as written to the gradebook by mod_zoom).

FIELD.NAME: otherpoints
FIELD.COMMENT: Points per mark for every other graded activity type. 0 means they do not count.

FIELD.NAME: topn
FIELD.COMMENT: How many top students the full leaderboard shows. 0 shows everyone.

FIELD.NAME: showinline
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to show a short summary on the course page.

TABLE.NAME: leaderboard_provision
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per course the automatic provisioner has handled, so a leaderboard a teacher deleted is never added back.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module the provisioner added or found. 0 when nothing was added.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: added, existing, removed, inheritedremoved or skipped.

FIELD.NAME: origin
FIELD.COMMENT: What started provisioning: create, restore, task, backfill or delete.
